crossRefs.note: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves…
but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.
Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.
He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of…
Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings…

translations.web: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
translations.bsb: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.”
translations.kjv: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
translations.asv: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.
